decision_hierarchy: 1. Map Asian Session High/Low (ASH/ASL) & prior 16-bar liquidity pools on H1/M30.
2. Confirm M15 institutional order flow & non-exhausted RSI14.
3. Wait for M5 Liquidity Sweep rejection wick or 3-bar Fair Value Gap (FVG) displacement during active institutional sessions.
4. Manage dynamically: shift SL to Break-Even at +1.07R, bank 50% at TP1 (+1.48R), and trail runner by 0.95x ATR.
institutional_entry_triggers: Asian High/Low Judas Sweep + M5 rejection close inside dealing range
M5 3-Candle Fair Value Gap (FVG) aligned with H1/M30 EMA9/21 & BOS
behavioral_mistakes_avoided: Never chases extended M5 breakout candles into exhausted RSI (>70 or <30)
Never trades during ROLLOVER_SPREAD_GUARD (21:00-00:00 UTC) when spreads widen
Never lets a +1R winning scalp turn into a full -1R loss (Break-Even ratchet active)

entry_conditions: Top-Down Macro Alignment (H1 + M30): EMA9/EMA21 directional agreement + Break of Structure (BOS) bias.
Setup Confirmation (M15): Pullback into Discount/Equilibrium (buys) or Premium/Equilibrium (sells) with FVG/Sweep confirmation.

Institutional Trigger (M5): Asian High/Low Judas Sweep + M5 rejection close inside dealing range OR M5 3-Candle Fair Value Gap (FVG) aligned with H1/M30 EMA9/21 & BOS during [ASIAN_RANGE_ACCUMULATION, LONDON_OPEN_JUDAS_SWEEP, NY_OVERLAP_INSTITUTIONAL_DRIVE].
Active Regime Filter: Execute only when M5 regime is in [VOLATILITY_EXPANSION, CONSOLIDATION_RANGING, TRENDING_BEARISH].
exit_conditions: Dynamic Partial Profit (TP1): Close 50% of position at +1.48R and immediately ratchet Stop-Loss to Break-Even (+0.10R).
Dynamic Runner Target (TP2) & Structure Trail: Trail remaining 50% behind 0.95x ATR14 / 8-bar swing high-low up to +3.35R.
Structure Flip Invalidation: Exit early if M15 structure flips against trade direction.
stop_loss_conditions: Structural Swing + Liquidity Sweep Invalidation: Place initial Stop-Loss beyond the sweep wick / 16-bar swing low-high on M5, bounded by Forge's learned 1.117x ATR14 excursion limit (P70 winning MAE = 0.8973x ATR).
Dynamic Break-Even Ratchet: Automatically move Stop-Loss to Entry + 0.10R once unrealized profit reaches +1.07R.
take_profit_conditions: Two-Stage Institutional Take-Profit: TP1 = +1.48R (50% scale-out at median MFE = 1.6859x ATR), TP2 = +3.35R (50% runner calibrated to P65-P80 MFE = 2.5499x-3.7471x ATR).
dynamic_management_rules: Break-Even Activation: +1.07R -> move SL to entry + cost buffer.
Partial Scale-Out: +1.48R -> lock 50% realized profit.
Chandelier / Structure Ratchet: trail remaining 50% by 0.95x ATR14 up to +3.35R.
Adaptive Session Guard: block new entries during ROLLOVER_SPREAD_GUARD.
strategy_specification.risk_reward_policy: Effective Institutional Reward-to-Risk = 2.28:1 (TP1=+1.48R, TP2=+3.35R) net of verified cTrader costs (0.74 bps).

decision_hierarchy: 1. Confirm D1 + H4 low-efficiency consolidation / range environment.
2. Map 16-bar & Asian Session High/Low dealing range boundaries on H1/M30.
3. Wait for M15 price to sweep or test extreme Discount (for longs) or Premium (for shorts) and print a rejection candle back inside the range.
4. Fade back to the 50% Equilibrium midpoint: shift SL to Break-Even at +0.89R, bank 50% at TP1 (+1.23R), and trail runner to opposite range boundary (+2.63R).
